basic_info.description:
2334 California Street Luxury 3 Bed, 4 Bath with Rooftop Patio & Park Views

Experience San Francisco living at its finest in this fully remodeled 5-bedroom, 4-bath residence located in the heart of Pacific Heights. With thoughtful design, modern finishes, and breathtaking views, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort and sophistication.

Features You'll Love

Spacious Layout: Five full bedrooms and four modern bathrooms, ideal for families, roommates, or those who love to host.
Private Outdoor Living: Enjoy multiple private balconies plus a rooftop patio with sweeping city views and direct sightlines of Lafayette Park.
Modern Convenience: In-unit washer and dryer, dishwasher, and updated kitchen with premium appliances.
Pet-Friendly: Bring your furry friends this home welcomes them.
Bright & Airy: Expansive windows bring in natural light throughout.

Location Highlights

Nestled on picturesque California Street, this residence places you just steps away from the greenery of Lafayette Park, charming Fillmore Street boutiques, award-winning restaurants, and easy access to public transit.

Key Details

3 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms
In-unit laundry
Private balconies + rooftop patio
Pet-friendly
Dishwasher & updated appliances
Incredible city & park views

This unit is a rental unit subject to the San Francisco Rent Ordinance, which limits evictions without just cause, and which states that any waiver by a tenant of their rights under the Rent Ordinance is void as contrary to public policy.

Tenant is responsible for all utilities.
